title: Figure 11: Racetrack memory concept using magnetic domain walls in nanowires
description: Color schematic captioned 'Figure 11. Racetrack Memory Concept. (Reference 83)', with panel A showing a U-shaped 'Vertical racetrack' nanowire with red and blue magnetic domains, and panels B-D showing 'Reading', 'Writing' and a 'Racetrack storage array'. It illustrates section '3.4 STT-Driven Motion of Magnetic Domain Walls'.
